name: A Night With: Emily
source:
After your college friend send you a intimate photo, she would do everything she can so you delete the image. This game focuses on a single, intense night of exploration and discovery, where every interaction with Spirit reveals deeper layers of the story.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当你的大学朋友给你发了一张亲密照片后，她会尽一切努力让你删除这张照片。这款游戏的重点是一个激烈的探索和发现之夜，与Spirit的每一次互动都会揭示故事的更深层次。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183980/]Steam[/url]]
